facts.business: Kizi Apparels Limited operates in the textile and apparel industry, engaged in manufacturing and trading of garments and related products.
facts.related_party_note: Related party transactions during FY 2025-26 include: Unsecured loan from Abhishek Nathani (Rs 18.83 lakh), Director remuneration to Abhishek Nathani (Rs 24.00 lakh) and Kiran Nathani (Rs 15.00 lakh), Reimbursement of expenses to Abhishek Nathani (Rs 80.94 lakh) and Kiran Nathani (Rs 0.43 lakh), Salary & incentive to Company Secretary Monica Mahaveer Jain (Rs 2.75 lakh) and relative of director Rajkumar Nathani (Rs 6.00 lakh), Trade receivable from Aaika Retail Private Limited (promoter director interested) of Rs 456.50 lakh, Goods and services from Aaika Retail Private Limited of Rs 453 lakh, Trade payable to Varsache Apparels Private Limited (entity in which relative of director is interested) of Rs 6.71 lakh. All transactions were at arm's length basis and approved by Board on 28.05.2025.
